name: Plunge Hot Springs + Wine: availability unconfirmed
intro: We have not verified a current Plunge hot-springs-and-wine package. This page previously described one as available; the operator's current published tours do not establish that offer. Do not use this listing to plan a combined booking.
whatHappens: Plunge currently publishes private wine tours, including its Wine Lovers itinerary, but we have not confirmed the hot-springs itinerary previously described here. Bathing entry, transport arrangements and a combined schedule remain unverified.
whoSuits: Readers researching Plunge's private wine tours should use the operator's current tour information. Its contact page describes a vehicle seating seven guests, not eight.
whoDoesnt: Anyone seeking a confirmed hot-springs-and-wine package. This listing does not establish availability or inclusions for that combination.
bookingIntelligence: Contact Plunge about its current offerings before arranging travel or separate bathing tickets. No hot-springs package booking link is offered here until the itinerary and inclusions are verified.

faq.question: Does this mean Plunge has stopped offering hot-springs tours?
faq.answer: No. We have not established that. We could not verify the combination in the current published tour information, so the previous availability and inclusion claims have been withdrawn.
